evidence.detail: Removed cards loading from person detail page (partial fix); decks loading still present
self.decks = person.decks triggers full deck load; colors are then computed by iterating all deck objects
person.decks lazy property calls deck.load_decks with no LIMIT, loading ALL decks for that person across all seasons
Deck table uses livedecktable (client-side), so server-side deck objects are only needed for the colors chart and has_decks flag

triage.fix_sketch: In decksite/data/deck.py add a person_color_counts(person_id, season_id) function that queries SELECT dc.colors FROM deck d JOIN deck_cache dc ON d.id=dc.deck_id WHERE d.person_id=X (with season filter) — deck_cache already stores pre-computed colors as JSON, so this avoids loading full Deck objects. In decksite/views/person.py:25-36 replace person.decks with this lightweight query for the chart and a COUNT query for has_decks. The livedecktable on the template fetches decks client-side so self.decks is no longer needed.
triage.notes: The cards-loading half of the original perf issue was fixed by d9c11c3; the decks-loading half (needed for the Colors Played chart) is still present and still hits for the all-seasons view.
